answer: The pearl cap is upheld at intake and mesa publishes the per-origin counts. A datacenter or proxy pool therefore cannot mint a swarm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, as every participant consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a trellis tag. That is 36 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
